topics.name: Adoption
topics.description: Belonging to God's family and receiving a child's inheritance.

topics.name: Redemption
topics.description: Christ's sacrificial death, ransom, and the freedom it purchases.

topics.name: God's Forgiveness
topics.description: God pardoning sin, removing estrangement, and restoring peace with himself.

topics.name: Justification
topics.description: Acceptance before God through Christ's righteousness rather than personal merit.

topics.name: In Christ
topics.description: New life, union with Christ, and sharing in his life and spiritual blessings.

topics.name: Holy Spirit
topics.description: The Spirit's indwelling, renewal, sanctification, leading, comfort, and seal.

topics.name: Consecration
topics.description: Wholehearted allegiance to God and offering one's life and actions to him.

topics.name: Loving God
topics.description: Loving, treasuring, and delighting personally in God or Christ.

topics.name: God's Love
topics.description: God's undeserved love, patient mercy, and gift of salvation.

topics.name: God's Guidance
topics.description: God personally leading, teaching, and directing the believer's course.

topics.name: Refuge
topics.description: God's presence, protection, and rescue amid danger or distress.

topics.name: Providence
topics.description: Confidence in God's care, provision, faithfulness, and ordering of present life.

topics.name: Perseverance
topics.description: Continuing in faith and good works, and God's keeping believers to the end.

topics.name: Scripture
topics.description: Reading, loving, keeping, and reflecting on Scripture as a source of truth and help.

topics.name: Prayer
topics.description: Approaching God in private or shared prayer, being heard, and seeking his help.

topics.name: Intercession
topics.description: Christ or the Spirit interceding, or believers praying specifically for others.

topics.name: Thanksgiving
topics.description: Deliberately thanking and praising God for his works and gifts.

topics.name: Serving Others
topics.description: Good works directed toward a neighbour's good, practical charity, and bearing others' burdens.

topics.name: Church Fellowship
topics.description: Belonging, gathering, worshipping, and maintaining unity within the church.

topics.name: Forgiving Others
topics.description: Responding to wrongs with forgiveness, forbearance, peace, and love.

topics.name: Gospel Witness
topics.description: Confessing and defending the gospel, a public Christian example, and concern for others' salvation.

topics.name: Integrity
topics.description: Truthfulness, integrity, a clear conscience, and speech that helps rather than harms.

topics.name: Stewardship
topics.description: Using time, opportunities, possessions, work, and civic responsibilities faithfully.

topics.name: Humility
topics.description: Renouncing pride, acknowledging dependence, and treating others gently.

topics.name: Self Control
topics.description: Governing desires and passions, rejecting worldly attachment, and giving up personal advantage.

topics.name: Watchfulness
topics.description: Recognising spiritual danger, avoiding occasions of sin, and guarding against drift.

topics.name: Repentance
topics.description: Recognising and confessing sin, examining one's ways, and returning to God.

topics.name: Patience
topics.description: Enduring affliction, waiting patiently, and submitting to God amid sorrow.

topics.name: Refining Trials
topics.description: Trials testing or refining faith, teaching dependence, and preparing believers for glory.

topics.name: Joy in Salvation
topics.description: Rejoicing in Christ, acceptance, pardon, and the blessings of salvation.

topics.name: Resisting Temptation
topics.description: The conflict with indwelling sin or Satan and active resistance through faith and spiritual armour.

topics.name: Christ's Strength
topics.description: Christ's strength, rest, comfort, protection, and sympathy for weak or tempted believers.

topics.name: Facing Death
topics.description: Human frailty, mortality, and facing one's death, including the believer's hope and peace.

topics.name: Resurrection
topics.description: The dead rising, bodily immortality and transformation, and reunion grounded in resurrection.

topics.name: Final Judgment
topics.description: Christ's appearing, the world's end, judgment, acquittal, and rewards at his coming.

topics.name: Heavenly Rest
topics.description: The promised home, rest, freedom from sorrow, and lasting happiness beyond this life.

topics.name: God's Presence
topics.description: Being with God and Christ, beholding their glory, knowing fully, and living in God's light.

topics.name: Heavenly Worship
topics.description: Heavenly worship, service, communion with the saints, and their reunion.

topics.name: Heavenly Glory
topics.description: Believers' final perfection, glory, victory, and sharing in Christ's kingdom.

topics.name: Holiness
topics.description: Becoming holy, bearing righteous fruit, and final freedom from sin.

reader_needs.name: Grief
reader_needs.description: For the death of someone loved and the hope of reunion.

reader_needs.name: Fearing Death
reader_needs.description: For fear of one's own death, with passages that directly address dying and life beyond the grave.

reader_needs.name: Financial Worry
reader_needs.description: For anxiety about material loss, daily needs, or future support.

reader_needs.name: Guilt
reader_needs.description: For confronting past wrongdoing and returning to God in confession and repentance.

reader_needs.name: Being Mistreated
reader_needs.description: For mistreatment, betrayal, hostility, and the struggle to respond without retaliation.

reader_needs.name: Recurring Sin
reader_needs.description: For repeated failure, inward sinful desires, and the struggle to resist them.

reader_needs.name: Seeking Direction
reader_needs.description: For understanding God's way through his leading, Scripture, and careful reflection.
